role: independent stage-3 continuity and actual-page review

visible_materials.sources: Only freeze-16 canonical snapshots for assigned pages and named context; source and figure SHA checked. Actual course/README.md and zensical.toml also read.
visible_materials.preview: http://127.0.0.1:8895/; existing executed Notebook outputs authored by course author
excluded_before_seal: raw model scores or implementation answers

limits: This is a third-stage source/continuity review, not a newly blind sequential student reading or a 350-page fresh acceptance. Context is explicitly bounded above.

Initial batch output included the chapter-19 and context-19.12 details folds before completion of the full body route. That early optional exposure is disclosed; no necessary B/C/Auto reasoning below relies on those folds. C.1/C.3/C.4/C.5 context details were withheld and not used.

All nine acceptance pages have no embedded figures in freeze-16. Figure necessity was still considered per page; actual prerequisite figures 14.11/14.15/C.4 were visually inspected and their served SVGs compared with frozen hashes.

Browser checks use existing rendered CPU Notebook outputs. Reviewer did not rerun these notebooks, download or run model artifacts, train, retest official models, inspect raw-score correctness, or independently establish formal GPU training results. The author CPU execution receipt is not reviewer execution evidence.
Source claims were checked for teaching continuity and internal interpretation; factual training/data/test counts remain claims requiring independent technical evidence.
AI process separation is not physical isolation or a human target-reader test. Shared filesystem; no delegation, content edits, commits, remote writes or messages outside this review occurred.

source_judgment.meaning: Nine-page teaching continuity source judgment; not independent verification of all empirical claims.

issues.location: Choice候選介紹→weather高集中錯誤例→19.17第二段整合候選擴充
issues.quote: 例如輸入「幫我預報明天天氣」，本世界的正解是不適用（none）；模型卻選兩盒追蹤（boxes），集中度約1。
issues.observation: 19.16先用卡片/地址/App/不適用介紹Choice，當頁實測錯例已含boxes；完整追蹤/算術的整合候選集合到19.17才明列。

identity.answer: Auto是C先判支援及材料充分，再由凍結規則為B選輪數的服務；B解題、C判斷、策略轉預算。
identity.source_quote: 三者不必被混成同一種模型能力

mechanism_or_property.answer: 固定effort優先用其設定，auto才選檔，兩者仍受支援範圍及硬上限；C兩次argmax而非機率門檻。policy搜尋出的核心追蹤全3輪，算術1輪。
mechanism_or_property.source_quote: 指定固定檔時，服務用已凍結的對應設定；auto時才採策略選檔

need_or_use.answer: 要在平均B輪數≤3內提高答對率，先攔缺資料再挑預算；更多計算不能補未提供事實，也不能把判斷器開銷免計。
need_or_use.source_quote: 目標是在完整題目平均B輪數不超過3下，使整個流程答對率最高

use.answer: 追蹤要兩盒初值/事件/查詢，算術要三運算元；不支援回unsupported，缺資訊回clarification_needed，完整題才交B。硬上限不悄悄加算，具體截限在19.19交代。

example_support.answer: 刪A初值後交換查B無唯一答案，能教充分性先於加算；實測Auto省84輪卻少對1題，沒有宣稱優於medium。學習式路由需新標籤，合理留後。
example_support.source_quote: Auto只把42道算術各少算2輪，共少84輪，也少對1題

transition_checks: 候選擴成客服+狀態追蹤+算術+none，明說相關題須訓練且繼承家族切分，不將任意新候選當自動受支援。
由規則Auto轉到19.18共同考卷成本；學習路由與中途續算都明列未交付，沒有拿待教方法代當本版成果。
pages.representation_and_examples: effort字串→凍結輪數→實際耗用三層沿用7.23，充分性標籤由世界規則而非B猜答案反推。小變化：材料缺初值而選high仍應澄清，與正文例一致。
pages.necessary_vs_optional: 全正文。學習成功率、收益預測與續算只是明確後續方向，當前規則Auto的操作與理由不依賴它們。

need_or_use.source_quote: 平均成本相同時比較正確率，或達同樣品質時比較成本

use.answer: 品質用2998題；時間用24題×3次、各暖機3次、CPU float32/2threads/batch1。計時入口第一次結構檢查後到C+B完成，非HTTP或載入的全服務延遲。
